auditNotes.platformSpecificNotes: HikaShop on Joomla 4.4.2, HikaShop Business 5.0.4. Per-menu-item sort+filter baked via filter_order_<menu-id-and-mode> hidden inputs (b.product_created, b.product_name, b.product_hit, a.ordering). Pagination is ?limitstart=N&limit=N (Joomla standard). perPage <select> values: 20/40/60/80/100/0 (0=all). Product detail URL = /product/<slug> (canonical); listings emit /<menu-alias>/product/<slug> (e.g. /recent/product/<slug>, /rifles/product/<slug>) all serving the same canonical content. Stock status NOT rendered on /recent listing cards (bare empty hikashop_product_stock_count span); the production maintain phase must fetch product detail to obtain stock — verifyMethod=detail-page set accordingly. reCAPTCHA-v3 script loaded site-wide via Contact Form 7-equivalent; does NOT gate catalog reads (verified by 200 responses on every probed path).
openQuestions: stock parsing on /recent listing returns 'unknown' for all cards because hikashop_product_stock_count span is empty in this menu config — production crawler should rely on detail-page parse for stockStatus; confirm generic-retail.ts hikashop extractor handles this.

limit=0 returns 8.7 MB of HTML in one shot — safe to use occasionally for full-catalog-sweep but production walks should use limit=100 with limitstart pagination (25 pages of ~100 each). The HikaShop AJAX listing endpoint (/index.php?option=com_hikashop&ctrl=product&task=listing&tmpl=raw&Itemid=267) referenced in clearance.html may be worth probing as a JSON-cleaner alternative but was not exercised this run.

/parts is a tile-only landing (0 direct products, 5 subcategory tiles); some of those subs (magwell, upper-receiver) are themselves tile-only with 10-11 further subcategories. The deep category tree (125 categories total per /category page header) is not documented in topLevelCategories.categories[] because /recent already gives 100% coverage; if operator wants per-category narrowing for keyword-alert routing, that's a separate concern.
